ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There is a six-membered ring in the figure, the top is a carbonyl C=O on the ring, the right ring carbon is connected to an OH substituent, and the bottom ring carbon is connected to an external imine fragment; this external carbon is simultaneously connected to an R group and forms a double bond with NH. The figure also shows an H+ separated from the main structure, and there are several curved arrows; the problem asks to ignore the arrows. Then reasoning: According to the problem, encode only atoms and bonds. The lower R group is represented by the wildcard *, and it is connected to the imine carbon, so the external fragment is written as *C(=N). This imine carbon is then connected to the saturated ring carbon of the six-membered ring. Traverse along the six-membered ring with the specified explicit bond types as C1C=CC(=O)C=C1, and add OH on the corresponding ring carbon, giving the main body *C(=N)C1C=CC(=O)C=C1O. The separated proton is written as an independent component [H+]. Therefore the complete SMILES is *C(=N)C1C=CC(=O)C=C1O.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First identify only the atoms and bonds in the transition-state drawing, disregarding all curved arrows. Encode the lower R group as a wildcard atom attached to the imine carbon, write the imine fragment as *C(=N), attach it to the saturated ring carbon, then traverse the six-membered ring as C1C=CC(=O)C=C1 with the OH substituent on the appropriate ring carbon. Finally append the detached proton shown in the image as a separate component, giving *C(=N)C1C=CC(=O)C=C1O.[H+].
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有一个六元环，顶部是环上羰基 C=O，右侧环碳连有 OH 取代基，底部环碳连有一个外侧亚胺片段；该外侧碳同时连 R 基并与 NH 形成双键。图中还画有一个与主体结构分离的 H+，并有若干弯箭头；题目要求忽略箭头。
再推理：按题意只编码原子和键。下方 R 基用通配符 * 表示，它连到亚胺碳，因此外侧片段写作 *C(=N)。该亚胺碳再连到六元环的饱和环碳。沿六元环按指定显式键型遍历为 C1C=CC(=O)C=C1，并在相应环碳上加 OH，得到主体 *C(=N)C1C=CC(=O)C=C1O。分离的质子作为独立组分写作 [H+]。因此完整 SMILES 为 *C(=N)C1C=CC(=O)C=C1O.[H+]。
